descriptions.description: 验收测试检查需求是否满足，而不是只看“构建（把源码转换为可运行或可发布的文件）通过”。
理解 Agent 的行动与检查循环，用生成练习表格的任务核对表头、行数和关键值，发现问题先修正，再继续下一步。
从能回退的小任务开始，比如在练习目录生成一份文件清单。
Agent 的记忆不能替代业务记录。练习把当前规则写进有生效日期的文件，并用一条旧规则检查它如何处理冲突。
Agent 写了计划不等于完成任务。练习设定可观察的完成标准，要求产物位置和检查记录，并亲自打开关键结果核对。
老板让 Agent 处理工作前，检查访问范围、写入动作、人工确认和恢复办法；用只读试点测试正常、缺资料和失败三种情况。
防止 Agent 无休止重试，先约定文件范围、重试次数、预算和交还人工的条件，遇到收费或提交结果不明时保留进度。
Agent 要读文件、写文件或发消息时，如何判断该给哪些权限？列出任务必需范围，先从只读或单目录开始，再核对新增请求。
固定工作流按预定步骤走，Agent 可以根据反馈选择下一步。
分清 AI 聊天与搜索引擎的用途，用软件支持哪些系统的问题练习查官网、看资料日期，并核对回答是否有原始来源。
检查点帮助下一次继续：当前目标、已完成、未完成、文件位置、关键限制和下一步。
不会编程也可从去空行等本地小工具练起。让 AI 先解释实现和改动文件，再测试普通、空白及异常输入，不把生成代码当验收。
让 AI 比较方案，先选与你任务有关的标准并逐项附来源；只比较已验证事实，未知项列测试办法，不让模型凭空打分。
企业 AI 免费初次咨询前，先说业务、现有做法和最麻烦的一步；用一个日常实例说明情况，再问清免费沟通与收费实施的边界。
费用可能包括工具、调用、配置开发、培训、审核和维护。
让 AI 修 Bug，先记复现步骤、期望与实际结果，再验证一个原因、做最小修改，最后复查原问题和相邻功能。
用 AI 写邮件，先给目的、收件人关系与已确认事实，缺项留空；检查称呼、承诺和附件后再由本人发送，不让草稿替你做决定。
给员工做 AI 入门培训，选他们能判断对错的小任务，同时演示正确与错误样例，再安排独立练习，明确何时交给人处理。
上传成功不等于 AI 读完文件。用三页各带不同标记的练习文档检查漏读，再处理扫描页、复杂表格和长附件的读取限制。
AI 图片可以帮助讨论构图和风格，但可能改变产品尺寸、接口、文字和材质。
AI 可能生成看似真实却没有依据的内容，常被叫作“幻觉”。
用两张虚构库存表练习 AI 差异核对，按商品编号与规格匹配，保留单位、时间和原始行；先列异常，不自动改账。
用日常说法区分 LLM、Token、上下文、Prompt、RAG、Agent、Skill、MCP、Harness 和 API，再练习把概念与具体产品名分开。
先选一个部门反复问的主题，整理有效版本、负责人与适用范围。
零基础学 AI 的一周练习安排：整理笔记、比较提问方式、核对原始来源，再复做一项任务，记录能重复使用的步骤。
AI 工具交付后如何维护？分别约定数据、规则、软件与账号负责人，写清更新后的复查，以及导出、备份和停用办法。
纪要不是把聊天写得正式，而是保留谁决定了什么、谁还没确认。
OCR 把图片里的文字转为可处理文本，不保证数字和表格关系都正确。
给企业 AI 小试点定清输入、周期和不做范围，保留正常、边界与失败样本，按预先约定的标准决定继续还是停止。
哪些资料不该直接上传给 AI？从虚构文本练习区分必要字段与个人标识，并核对组织的数据规则，不拿真实客户文件试功能。
尺寸、材质、认证、适用范围和效果必须有依据。
先访谈实际操作者，再整理步骤、前提、例外和完成标准。
AI 清洗表格前，先区分编号、数量和金额，说明单位与空值规则，再对比处理前后的行数和关键合计，避免只看排版。
哪些工作适合先用 AI？列出五项重复任务，比较频率、出错后果与检查难度，再选一项输入稳定、容易核对的只读试点。
翻译要保留数字、条件、否定和术语，不能只看语句流畅。
用 AI 写周报，先把记录标为已完成、进行中、计划或阻断，再附实际产物，检查改稿有没有把准备做的事写成成果。
让 AI 先问关键问题，又不一直等你回答：分清必要信息与可默认信息，限定首轮问题，并先完成不依赖答案的部分。
分支让一组修改在独立的版本线上进行，便于比较和合并。
把长任务按可检查的中间结果拆开：先读资料，再列问题，再写草稿，最后核对。
挑选企业 AI 提效服务商，先提供脱敏流程说明，让候选方按同一口径列交付、范围和报价，再核对案例证据与责任。
新手选 AI 工具，先用同一份练习文本比较结果与修改成本，再核对价格、数据规则和退出方式，避免只看榜单买会员。
API Key 是访问服务的凭证，不是普通配置示例。
保存改变当前文件，Commit 则把一组变更记入版本历史并附说明。
AI 为什么聊久了会忘事？理解上下文窗口的容量限制，练习用一页摘要保留目标、限制和已确认事实，再开启下一项任务。
把会议纪要要求写成纯文字 Skill，规定输出栏目和原文定位，再换一份记录复测，检查它会不会擅自确定负责人。
理解软件依赖为什么会带来更多文件。安装前问清要补哪个能力，比较现有办法，并保留锁定版本和安装记录。
分清 GitHub 源码 ZIP 与可运行的 Release 附件，从项目说明找到官方发布入口，再核对平台支持和可用校验值。
Embedding 把内容表示成一组数字，用于比较某种相似性。
结合品牌客服协作经历，讲清资料怎么整理、回答如何查来源，以及何时交回人工。
提示词、RAG 知识库与微调怎么选？先写清一项可测试的失败，补足指令和资料，再判断是否值得投入训练与评测。
选一个小、可检查、做错也容易恢复的任务，比如把个人笔记改成待办清单。
指出哪句话错、错在什么、正确规则是什么，比说“重写”更有用。
公开仓库内容可被他人读取和复制；私有仓库限制访问，但也不适合把秘密凭证直接当普通文件存。
语言模型根据上下文逐步生成后续的文字单位，而不是从一个固定答案库复制整段结论。
从单据、库存和流水的核对入手，结合库存与扫码项目，判断哪一步值得先改。
好的 Issue 说明环境、复现步骤、预期、实际和相关错误。
只读试点能先验证找不找得到正确资料，而不碰业务记录。
MCP 连上后为什么仍会查询失败？画清 AI 应用、连接服务与业务系统的关系，分开检查账号、额度、费用和失败环节。
看完成同类任务的总时间、错误、返工和人工复核，不只看模型生成速度。
选大模型不只看参数和单次价格。用相同输入比较正常、缺资料与边界情况，连同人工修正时间一起判断模型是否够用。
多 Agent 是分工，不是自动更可靠。用资料检查与文字编辑的例子分清输入、产物和合并责任，避免多个角色同改一个文件。
神经网络用多层计算把输入变成输出，训练时调整其中的参数。
开源不代表可以随意商用。先读仓库 LICENSE 与依赖说明，区分内部使用和分发，再核对原许可证要求，不能只听 AI 总结。
老板想用 AI 提效，先看员工怎样完成一件真实工作，把重复动作与必要判断分开，再选低风险环节试点，不急着买系统。
Prompt 是给 AI 的指令与相关信息。通过一项小任务练习说清输入、目标和输出要求，再检查回答是否符合原来的需求。
外部网页、文档或技能可能夹带“忽略原要求”等指令，诱使 Agent 越权。
用一组输入和理想输出教 AI 按格式整理信息，再加一个缺日期的样例示范留空，最后换新材料检查是否真正理解规则。
只给影响判断的背景：谁在用、现在怎么做、卡在哪里、希望得到什么。
Pull Request 是提议合并一组修改并供人讨论审查的入口。
RAG 是先检索相关资料，再把找到的内容交给模型回答。
外行审查 AI 改代码的计划，先说清当前问题与期望行为，再核对拟改文件、不改范围和验证办法，不必先学完全部语法。
看不懂 GitHub 项目的 README？先找用途、系统要求、启动前提、操作步骤和许可证，并确认文档对应当前版本。
仓库保存项目文件及版本历史，便于查看谁在什么时候改了什么。
用 AI 改文案时，先锁定事实、数字与承诺，只调整表达；通过对照原稿检查是否增添了原文没有的意思。
把好用的 AI 提问保存成模板：用占位符替换具体信息，附正常与缺信息样例，再记录修改日期和适用范围。
在 Agent Skills 格式中，SKILL.md 承载元信息和任务指令，旁边可放脚本、参考材料与资源。
安装 Skill 前先查发布者、版本、脚本、依赖和数据去向，再用无敏感资料的练习目录小范围试跑，不按下载量判断安全。
Skill 装好却没生效，先分清安装、启用、任务匹配和执行。用最小任务检查未加载、缺工具或缺权限，不反复安装同一包。
偶尔做一次用提示词模板，反复做且需配套资源时再考虑 Skill。先记录稳定步骤和例外，判断封装技能是否值得。
让 AI 输出固定字段或表格，先定字段顺序、允许值、金额币种与缺失处理，再用缺信息样本检查它会不会擅自补写。
终端用文字命令操作程序。新手先练查看目录和文件列表，并逐段理解 AI 提供的命令，单独审查删除、管理员权限和下载脚本。
训练会调整模型参数，推理是用已有模型处理当前输入。
Agent 通常指能结合工具、反馈和多步行动推进目标的系统。
AI 是人工智能的简称，涵盖识别、预测、生成等多种技术，既有基于规则的办法，也有从数据学习的办法。
FDE 常指 Forward Deployed Engineer，工作方式偏向贴近客户流程，把技术落到实际场景。
GitHub 是围绕代码和项目协作的平台，也能阅读文档、报告问题和查看版本。
Harness 在 Agent 讨论里通常指让模型可靠工作的一套运行配套，例如工具、状态记录、权限和检查。
用浅显例子区分大语言模型与聊天软件，了解文件和联网能力为何取决于具体产品，并检查回答是否有依据。
分清本地预览与正式上线：记录两种地址，在本地检查关键流程和手机宽度，发布后再确认公开网站的实际版本。
MCP 是让 AI 应用与外部数据、工具交互的一种开放协议。
Skill 通常是一包任务说明及可选资源，帮助兼容的 Agent 按某种办法做事。
Token 是模型处理文字的单位，可能对应字、词的一部分或其他片段。
WorkBuddy 是可结合任务、文件及工具工作的 AI 助手产品。
WorkBuddy 连接邮箱或文档前，先确认要读什么、能否写入或外发，以及如何撤销授权；用非敏感内容做只读验证。
用 WorkBuddy 整理文件前，先生成旧名、新名和原因的对照表；处理重名、缺日期等情况，确认后只对练习副本执行。
用 WorkBuddy 从练习 notes.txt 生成 tasks.txt：说明输入、动作、产物和限制，再从结果入口打开文件，核对有没有遗漏或补写。
用 WorkBuddy 整理会议文字，分清讨论、决定、待办和未定项，给待办保留原句与负责人状态，核对后再分享纪要文件。
把提示翻译成真实动作：读哪个目录、写哪个文件、执行什么命令、是否外发。
选择 WorkBuddy 技能时，先判断现有能力是否够用，再读候选技能的输入、输出、脚本和权限，只启用当前任务需要的部分。
用 WorkBuddy 看 Excel，先说明字段与行数，再列缺字段、重复编号和数量异常，人工核对后才考虑改原表或业务系统。
WorkBuddy 卡住或没产物，先分清排队、运行、报错和等待确认，再查结果入口、工具与额度，保留错误原文，避免重复建任务。
让 WorkBuddy 写出可用文档，先给读者、用途、已确认事实和不许承诺的内容；先审提纲，再逐项核对日期、价格和说法。
Acceptance tests check requirements rather than only a successful build (turning source into runnable or publishable files).
Learn an agent's feedback loop by checking a generated practice table. Verify headings, row counts and key values before proceeding.
Start with a reversible task such as creating an inventory in a practice directory.
Keep critical agent rules in an inspectable, dated file. Test a conflicting old rule to check that remembered information does not override current instructions.
Tell an agent's plan from completed work. Set an observable acceptance criterion, request the artifact and check record, then open the result yourself.
Check agent access, changes, human review and recovery before business use. Start with a read-only pilot covering normal, incomplete and failed cases.
Set agent scope, retry limits, budget and handoff conditions before work starts. Preserve progress when charges or uncertain submissions require a stop.
Decide which permissions an AI agent needs. Separate file reading, writes and external actions, and start with read-only or single-folder access.
A workflow follows predefined steps; an agent can choose steps based on feedback.
Compare AI chat with search using a question about supported operating systems. Check the official source, its date and what the answer actually supports.
A checkpoint records the goal, completed and pending work, file locations, constraints and next action.
Start AI coding with a small offline tool, such as removing blank lines. Review affected files and test normal, empty and unusual inputs.
Compare options with AI using task-specific criteria and supporting sources. Keep unknowns explicit and propose checks instead of inventing scores.
Prepare for an initial AI consultation with your business, current process and hardest step. Bring one example and clarify discussion versus implementation.
Costs can include subscriptions, usage, configuration, development, training, review and maintenance.
Debug with AI by recording reproduction steps and testing one likely cause. Make a minimal fix, then retest the original issue and nearby behavior.
Draft an email with AI using a clear purpose and verified facts. Leave gaps explicit and review the recipient, commitments and attachments before sending.
Train staff on AI with a familiar, checkable task. Show useful and incorrect outputs, practice independently and make human escalation clear.
Check whether AI read a whole file with a different marker on each of three practice pages. Identify omissions before trusting a document summary.
Generated images can help discuss composition and style, but may alter dimensions, ports, text or materials.
An AI hallucination is plausible content without adequate grounding.
Practice inventory reconciliation with two fictional tables. Match item IDs and specifications, retain source rows and report exceptions without adjusting stock.
Learn ten AI terms in plain language, including LLM, RAG, agents, skills, MCP and harnesses. Separate what a concept means from a product name.
Choose one recurring question area and organize current versions, owners and scope.
Plan a beginner's first week with AI: organize notes, compare prompts, verify a fact and repeat one task to build a reusable procedure.
Plan maintenance after an AI tool is delivered. Assign owners for data, rules, software and accounts, with retesting, backup and shutdown procedures.
Minutes preserve decisions and unresolved matters rather than merely formalizing conversation.
OCR turns image text into machine-readable text but can misread digits and table structure.
Design a small business AI pilot with approved inputs, exclusions and a time limit. Test normal and failed cases against preset acceptance criteria.
Decide what not to upload to AI. Use fictional text to identify necessary fields and private identifiers, then check your organization's data rules.
Dimensions, materials, certifications, compatibility and results need evidence.
Interview the actual operator and document steps, prerequisites, exceptions and completion checks.
Clean a spreadsheet with AI by defining IDs, quantities, amounts, units and missing values. Compare row counts and key totals before and after.
Choose a first business AI task by comparing repeated work, frequency, error consequences and review effort. Select one limited, checkable read-only pilot.
Check numbers, conditions, negation and terminology rather than fluency alone.
Write an AI-assisted weekly report by labeling completed, ongoing, planned and blocked work. Attach actual outputs and check for exaggerated results.
Have AI ask useful clarifying questions without stalling. Separate essential facts from defaults and let independent work proceed while answers are pending.
A branch lets work proceed on a separate line of development for comparison and merging.
Split work into checkable stages: read, identify questions, draft and verify.
Compare business AI service providers using one sanitized workflow brief. Request comparable scopes and quotes, then check case evidence and delivery ownership.
Choose an AI tool by testing the same text in two tools. Compare errors and correction effort, then check pricing, data terms and exit options.
An API key is a credential, not an ordinary example value.
Saving changes a file; a commit records a set of changes in history with a message.
Understand why long AI conversations lose context. Make a one-page brief of goals, constraints and confirmed facts before starting a new task.
Make a text-only meeting-notes skill with output sections and source locations. Retest different notes for invented decisions or responsibilities.
Understand software dependencies before installing a package. Check the missing capability, consider existing tools and retain version locks and install records.
Tell a GitHub source ZIP from a release asset. Use the official release entry, check platform support and verify publisher checksums when provided.
An embedding represents content numerically for similarity comparisons.
Draw on a customer-support project to organize documents, check answer sources and define when a person must take over.
Choose between prompting, RAG and fine-tuning by identifying one testable failure. Try clearer instructions and suitable sources before considering training.
Choose something small, checkable and reversible, such as turning personal notes into tasks.
Identify the wrong passage, the reason and the correct rule.
Public repositories can be read and copied; private ones restrict access but are not a reason to store secrets as ordinary files.
A language model generates successive text units conditioned on context rather than copying a complete fixed answer.
Use inventory and barcode projects to examine records, stock movements and corrections, then choose one step to improve.
A useful issue includes environment, reproduction, expected and actual behavior, and errors.
A read-only pilot tests whether the right information can be found without changing business records.
Understand MCP versus an API by mapping the AI app, connector and business system. Separate account access, quotas, costs and the failing layer.
Measure total task time, errors, rework and review, not generation speed alone.
Compare AI models on the same normal, incomplete and edge-case tasks. Include human correction effort when deciding whether a model is good enough.
Understand multi-agent work through separate source-checking and editing roles. Define outputs and one merger rather than sharing the same file.
A neural network maps inputs to outputs through layers of computation with adjustable parameters.
Check an open-source project's LICENSE and dependency notices before commercial use. Separate internal use from distribution and read the original obligations.
Start business AI improvement by observing one real workflow. Separate repeated steps from necessary judgment and choose a low-risk pilot before buying tools.
Learn what a prompt contains and practice explaining one small task. State the input, goal and expected output, then check the result against the request.
External pages, files or skills can contain instructions intended to override the task.
Guide AI with an input and desired output, plus an example with a missing date. Test new material to check that the format works beyond the example.
Provide background that changes the decision: who uses the result, the current process, the blockage and the desired outcome.
A pull request proposes changes for review and merging.
RAG retrieves relevant information before generating an answer from it.
Review an AI code-change plan without knowing every syntax detail. Check the defect, intended behavior, affected files, exclusions and validation steps.
Read a GitHub README by finding its purpose, supported systems, prerequisites, steps and license. Check that the instructions match the project version.
A repository holds project files and revision history.
Rewrite with AI while preserving meaning. Fix the facts and commitments first, then compare the draft with the original for unsupported additions.
Turn an AI prompt into a reusable template with placeholders, normal and incomplete examples, a revision date and a clear intended scope.
In the Agent Skills format, SKILL.md contains metadata and instructions, with optional scripts, references and assets alongside it.
Review a skill's publisher, version, scripts, dependencies and data destinations before installation. Test practice input with limited access first.
Troubleshoot a skill that is installed but inactive. Use a minimal matching task to separate loading, tool and permission failures before reinstalling.
Choose a prompt template for occasional tasks or a skill for repeatable procedures with resources. Record stable steps and exceptions before packaging.
Get structured AI output by defining fields, allowed values, currencies and missing-data rules. Test an incomplete sample for invented values.
Learn terminal commands through directory and file-listing tasks. Read proposed commands part by part before considering deletion or elevated access.
Training changes model parameters; inference uses a model on current input.
An agent combines a model with tools, feedback and multiple actions toward a goal.
AI stands for artificial intelligence and includes recognition, prediction and generation, using approaches such as rules or learning from data.
FDE commonly means Forward Deployed Engineer, a role working close to customer workflows to implement technology.
GitHub hosts code and project collaboration, including documentation, issues and versions.
In agent discussions, a harness is the surrounding execution setup: tools, state, permissions and checks.
